'''Business and economy'''
*[[Economic impact of the 2026 Iran war]]
**[[Malaysia]] announces a [[remote work]] policy for [[Government of Malaysia|government]] officials and employees of [[state-owned enterprise]]s starting April 15 to reduce fuel consumption amid rising [[Energy policy of Malaysia|energy]] costs linked to the Iran war. The government also reduces [[Fossil fuel subsidies|subsidized fuel]] [[Import quota|quota]]s while maintaining [[Value-based pricing|market-based pricing]] for unsubsidized fuel. [https://www.channelnewsasia.com/asia/malaysia-civil-servants-work-home-iran-war-6032981 (AFP via CNA)]
**The [[Taiwan]]ese [[Ministry of Transportation and Communications (Taiwan)|transport ministry]] announces that [[List of airlines of Taiwan|airlines]] will increase [[fuel surcharge]]s on international flights by 157 percent starting April 7, following a rise in global [[Price of oil|oil prices]] linked to the Iran war. [https://www.straitstimes.com/asia/east-asia/taiwan-airlines-to-hike-fuel-surcharges-157-on-international-flights (AFP via ''The Straits Times'')]
